verdict.rationale: The docs treat balances, ownership, and transactions as distinct data products, with separate refresh webhooks per data type and use cases tied to different data needs (ACH with balances, Connect payouts with ownership). That implies product-scoped data access rather than one all-or-nothing grant. However, nothing in the pack shows how a developer requests only specific scopes, or how the user consents per scope. Missing for 10: a documented per-scope permissions/consent request mechanism, explicit data-minimization controls (e.g. limiting accounts or history), consent-screen evidence showing only the requested scopes, and independent corroboration.
